answers.answer:
Finding as of 29 October 2026: The legal identity of the entity responsible for ProctoAI is unverified, and its status as a live, operational service is not established.

### 1. Legal identity and organizational form

The source repository, [shreeram312/AI-Proctored-System](https://github.com/shreeram312/AI-Proctored-System?utm_source=chatgpt.com), is hosted under an individual GitHub account displaying the name Shreeram Mutukundu. 

[image](https://www.google.com/s2/favicons?domain=https://github.com\&sz=32)

GitHub



However, the public evidence does not establish:

- Whether the developer operates as an individual, registered business, company, university project team, or another legal entity.
- The registered legal name, jurisdiction, registration number, or business address of a responsible organization.
- Which entity legally owns, operates, and provides ProctoAI to end users.
- Whether any third party has assumed provider or operator responsibilities.

Legal entity classification: Undetermined. GitHub ownership identifies a repository maintainer, not necessarily the legal provider or deployer.

### 2. Deployment and operational status

There is evidence of a possible public deployment:

- The repository lists [ai-proctored-system.vercel.app](https://ai-proctored-system.vercel.app/?utm_source=chatgpt.com) as its project website.
- Its README documents working student, teacher, and AI-proctoring features.
- It also describes several capabilities as future work and provides instructions for running the project locally. 

  [image](https://www.google.com/s2/favicons?domain=https://github.com\&sz=32)

  GitHub



I could not independently verify that the Vercel application is currently accessible and functioning. More importantly, a deployment URL alone does not establish that ProctoAI is being used for actual examinations, has active customers, or is offered as a production service.

Operational classification: Unverified — potentially deployed as a demo/prototype, but neither production operation nor internal-only status is confirmed.

### 3. Implication for the compliance audit

The assessment should retain “Undetermined” for the responsible legal role and “Not confirmed” for live production deployment.

To resolve these findings, the project owner or responsible enterprise needs to provide its legal registration or organizational identity, explain whether it develops/provides/deploys the system, and confirm the production URL, go-live date, customer or institutional use, and whether real examination candidates are currently processed.

Until that evidence is obtained, it would be inappropriate to classify ProctoAI definitively as either a commercial live service or an internal/pre-release project.

answers.answer:
## ProctoAI — Sector and Vietnam Personal Data Assessment

Assessment as of 29 October 2026:

| Question                                                                       | Finding                                       | Confidence                                         |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | --------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------- |
| Primary economic sector of the operating entity                                | Undetermined                                  | Insufficient information about the legal operator  |
| Sector most closely associated with the system's intended use                  | Education and training / examination services | High                                               |
| Whether the system is designed to process personal data                        | Yes                                           | High                                               |
| Whether it currently processes personal data of individuals located in Vietnam | Not confirmed                                 | Insufficient deployment and user-location evidence |

### 1. Primary economic sector

ProctoAI is an automated examination proctoring application designed for teachers and students. Its documented functions include administering examinations, monitoring candidates through webcams, detecting potentially prohibited objects, and presenting incident logs to teachers. 

[image](https://www.google.com/s2/favicons?domain=https://github.com\&sz=32)

GitHub



This establishes education/training as the intended application sector, but not the operating entity's primary registered economic activity.

A software development business could operate ProctoAI as an IT service for educational institutions. Alternatively, a school, university, or training provider could operate it internally. The available repository documentation does not distinguish between these arrangements.

Recommended audit entry: `Operator economic sector: Undetermined; intended application domain: Education/training (online examinations).`

### 2. Processing personal data of individuals in Vietnam

The reviewed source code confirms that ProctoAI is designed to collect and process personal data, including:

- User identity and account information: name, email address, password hash and user role, defined in [`backend/models/userModel.js`](https://github.com/shreeram312/AI-Proctored-System/blob/9ddb361e4cd52aafe4e1d0763f57005a607efae6/backend/models/userModel.js?utm_source=chatgpt.com).
- Examination monitoring records: username, email, exam ID, incident counts, screenshot URLs and detection timestamps, defined in [`backend/models/cheatingLogModel.js`](https://github.com/shreeram312/AI-Proctored-System/blob/9ddb361e4cd52aafe4e1d0763f57005a607efae6/backend/models/cheatingLogModel.js?utm_source=chatgpt.com).
- Webcam images: the frontend can capture candidate images and upload screenshots to Uploadcare following detected events, as implemented in [`WebCam.jsx`](https://github.com/shreeram312/AI-Proctored-System/blob/9ddb361e4cd52aafe4e1d0763f57005a607efae6/frontend/src/views/student/Components/WebCam.jsx?utm_source=chatgpt.com).

However, none of these code paths establishes the geographical location of actual users. I found no verified evidence that the system currently serves Vietnamese institutions, has candidates located in Vietnam, or processes their personal data in production.

Recommended audit entry: `Vietnam-based individuals' personal data processed: Unknown / Not confirmed.`

This must not be interpreted as a confirmed No. If the system is deployed for candidates located in Vietnam, the relevant Vietnamese personal-data protection requirements need to be assessed, regardless of whether the operating entity is primarily an education provider or a software company.

### 3. Information required to resolve both questions

The responsible operator should confirm its primary registered business activity, whether ProctoAI is used internally or supplied to educational customers, and whether any actual examination participants are located in Vietnam.

For the personal-data question, suitable evidence would include customer jurisdictions, deployment records, and privacy/data-flow documentation, preferably using aggregated information rather than disclosing individual candidates' records.

Overall conclusion: ProctoAI's application domain is education/training, but the operator's primary economic sector remains undetermined. The software has personal-data processing functionality, while actual processing of data belonging to individuals located in Vietnam remains unverified.

answers.answer:
## ProctoAI — Personal Data Collection and Third-Party Transfers

Assessment as of 29 October 2026: ProctoAI is designed to collect and process personal data, and its source code explicitly provides for transferring webcam screenshots to an external service, Uploadcare.

However, the full extent of third-party sharing beyond the source code remains unknown. I cannot confirm that these processing activities are currently occurring in production or that the operator has disclosed every external recipient.

### 1. Personal data collection and processing

| Data category                             | Evidence from source code                       | Assessment                  |
| ----------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------- | --------------------------- |
| Student/teacher names and email addresses | `backend/models/userModel.js`                   | Confirmed in the data model |
| Passwords and account roles               | Password hashing with bcrypt; role field        | Confirmed in the data model |
| Exam participation identifiers            | `examId`, username and email in cheating logs   | Confirmed in the data model |
| Webcam images                             | Browser-side screenshot capture in `WebCam.jsx` | Confirmed implementation    |
| Monitoring results                        | Incident counts, screenshot URLs and timestamps | Confirmed implementation    |

The webcam component uses TensorFlow\.js COCO-SSD to detect people and objects, then captures a screenshot when a relevant monitoring event is recorded.

Importantly, the implementation detects people and objects; it does not establish operational facial identity recognition.

Sources: [User model](https://github.com/shreeram312/AI-Proctored-System/blob/9ddb361e4cd52aafe4e1d0763f57005a607efae6/backend/models/userModel.js?utm_source=chatgpt.com), [cheating-log model](https://github.com/shreeram312/AI-Proctored-System/blob/9ddb361e4cd52aafe4e1d0763f57005a607efae6/backend/models/cheatingLogModel.js?utm_source=chatgpt.com), [webcam implementation](https://github.com/shreeram312/AI-Proctored-System/blob/9ddb361e4cd52aafe4e1d0763f57005a607efae6/frontend/src/views/student/Components/WebCam.jsx?utm_source=chatgpt.com).

### 2. Third-party sharing and transfers

Code-confirmed

Uploadcare — external screenshot storage

The webcam component calls `client.uploadFile(file)` and receives a CDN URL. This establishes an implemented mechanism for sending candidate screenshots from the browser to Uploadcare when incidents are detected. Actual production uploads have not been independently verified.

Conditional

MongoDB — database storage

The backend connects through `process.env.MONGO_URL` and stores examination logs. Whether the database is self-hosted or operated by a third-party cloud provider cannot be determined without the deployment configuration.

[Database connection code](https://github.com/shreeram312/AI-Proctored-System/blob/9ddb361e4cd52aafe4e1d0763f57005a607efae6/backend/config/db.js?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

Code-confirmed

Teacher-facing access to candidate records

The backend provides an authenticated endpoint for retrieving examination cheating logs, including candidate identifiers and screenshot references. This is an intended disclosure within the application, but whether teachers belong to a separate legal organization is unknown.

[Cheating-log controller](https://github.com/shreeram312/AI-Proctored-System/blob/9ddb361e4cd52aafe4e1d0763f57005a607efae6/backend/controllers/cheatingLogController.js?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

Unverified

Other external recipients and cross-border transfers

The inspected code does not establish whether personal data also reaches hosting providers, logging and monitoring services, subprocessors, educational customers, or overseas data centers.

### 3. What cannot be concluded from the repository

The source code does not establish whether there are additional recipients beyond those visible in implementation, whether screenshots are accessible to other parties, where data is geographically stored, or whether onward sharing and international transfers occur.

Resolving those issues requires an operator-provided data-flow map, third-party processor/subprocessor register, hosting configuration, data-processing agreements, and retention/deletion policies, together with evidence of actual deployment.

### Recommended compliance-audit conclusion

| Audit field                             | Recommended entry                                       |
| --------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------- |
| Personal data collection and processing | Confirmed in implementation; live processing unverified |
| External third-party data transfers     | Confirmed mechanism — Uploadcare screenshot uploads     |
| Other third-party disclosures           | Undetermined                                            |
| International personal-data transfers   | Undetermined                                            |
| Completeness of recipient disclosure    | Not established                                         |

Overall: ProctoAI has clearly implemented personal-data collection and external screenshot-upload functionality. The operator's complete sharing practices, including any transfers beyond those evident in the code, cannot be determined without operational and contractual evidence.
